headline: SIMPLER ADMINISTRATIVE PROCEDURES: A New Measure Is Introduced That Also Reduces Costs for Citizens
summary: From Monday, October 12, citizens across Serbia can submit ten types of requests themselves at cadastre counters. The rules allow certain property matters to be resolved without professional intermediaries.
why: Property registration procedures affect real estate transactions, and simpler cadastre processes can lower transaction costs in the housing market.
